q: Since air pollution is mainly caused by the combustion of fossil fuels, the ____ of these fuels can reduce air pollution.
e: Since air pollution is mainly caused by the combustion of fossil fuels, the controlled consumption of these fuels can reduce air pollution. The controlled consumption of these fuels can reduce air pollution.

q: The most basic solution for air pollution is to move away from fossil fuels, replacing them with alternative energies like solar, water and ____.
e: The most basic solution for air pollution is to move away from fossil fuels, replacing them with alternative energies like solar, water and wind. Replacing them with alternative energies like solar, water and wind.

q: Shifting to electric vehicles and promoting ____ (i.e., carpooling and public transports) could reduce air pollution.
e: Shifting to electric vehicles and promoting shared mobility (i.e., carpooling and public transports) could reduce air pollution. Promoting shared mobility (i.e., carpooling and public transports) could reduce air pollution.

q: The air pollution can be reduced by applying green building technology from planning to design, construction, operation, maintenance, renovation and ____.
e: The air pollution can be reduced by applying green building technology from planning to design, construction, operation, maintenance, renovation and demolition. Listen for demolition in that sentence.

q: Air quality is measured by devices using laser-based technologies, ____, etc.
e: Air quality is measured by devices using laser-based technologies, flame ionisation, etc. Air quality is measured by devices using laser-based. Listen for flame ionisation in that sentence.

q: All the collected data are compiled into a value scale, called the ____ (AQI).
e: All the collected data are compiled into a value scale, called the Air Quality Index (AQI). Listen for Air Quality Index in that sentence.

q: An AQI is defined as an overall scheme that transforms weighted values of individual air pollution related parameters into a single number or ____.
e: An AQI is defined as an overall scheme that transforms weighted values of individual air pollution related parameters into a single number or set of numbers. An AQI is defined as an overall scheme.

q: Air quality is considered satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk when the AQI value is ____.
e: Air quality is considered satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk when the AQI value is 0 to 50. And air pollution poses little or no risk when the AQI value is 0 to 50.

e: However, for some pollutants there may be a moderate health concern for a very small number of people who are unusually sensitive to air pollution when the AQI value is 51 to 100. Listen for 51 to 100 in that sentence.

q: Smoking tobacco through the use of cigarettes and cigars also releases ____ into the air.
e: Smoking tobacco through the use of cigarettes and cigars also releases toxic pollutants into the air. Through the use of cigarettes and cigars also.

q: The garbage released out of houses gets dumped as landfills which generate ____, a highly inflammable gas.
e: The garbage released out of houses gets dumped as landfills which generate methane, a highly inflammable gas. Listen for methane in that sentence.
